name: Ring of the Elemental Adepts
body:
Aura: moderate evocation and invocation; CL 9th; Slot: ring; Price: 25,000 gp, Weight: –.

DESCRIPTION

These rings enhance the power of storm knights, earth lords, fire lords, and arcane casters specialized in one of the elements (air, earth, fire or water). While wearing one of these rings, every elemental spell of the user’s focus type (air, earth, fire, or water) has +1 added to its save DC. Once per day, when the wearer of the ring successfully saves vs. an attacker’s spell with an elemental descriptor (air, earth, fire or water), he may transform some of its energy and use it for his own magical defense. This defense automatically takes the form of one of the effects listed below on the wearer’s next turn, as a move action, if he so desires. The defense effect always matches the elemental type of the attacker’s spell.

Effects:

Air: wind wall
Earth: stoneskin (protects against 30 pts of damage total)
Fire: fire shield
Water: fog cloud

The defensive effect must be used on the ring wearer’s next turn, and lasts for only one round.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells fire shield, fog cloud, stoneskin, protection from energy, wind wall; Cost: 12,500 gp
